slice: W13 Play lifecycle status independent security/state review r1632
sourceState: New canonical uncommitted files; reviewed hashes match the successful producer build inputs.
recommendation: Accept this reader slice for parent-owned CLI integration. This is not an integrated CLI, provider-account, testing-ready, release or GA acceptance.
requirements: mixer-product-plan.md section 15; AGENTS.md ownership, process holds and artifact retention.

reviewResults.evidence: PlayTestingRequest validates bounded ASCII package/track path components and canonical positive Int32 version text (lines 15-39). The fixed HTTPS endpoint and exact response URL bind the application and track (138-152). Every decoded release must repeat the exact track; identity uses activeArtifacts.versionCode, never releaseName (180-197). Previous observations require complete identity equality (83-86). Offline tests cover response URL, body track, absent version and cross-identity history.

All six specified lifecycle states are preserved. Unspecified/future states, duplicate matching releases, duplicate or nonpositive artifact versions, malformed shapes/numbers, duplicate JSON keys and excessive releases fail unresolved. The canonical JSON guard rejects ambiguous keys before decoding. Tests exercise these rejection paths. Missing/null releases and upload-shaped objects yield not-observed with exit 2; this explicit limitation never establishes publication or testing readiness.

Only an exact matching current lifecycle can produce published-on-track. Qualification remains provider-observation-only; testingReadiness, testLinks and productionAvailability are unverified (64-80). The published next step explicitly warns about partial/halted rollouts (111). Official Google documentation confirms that warning. Empty/upload-only responses cannot produce exit 0. No upload, review-submission, publication or tester-access action is implemented.

A request is GET-only; no write endpoint, resubmission or application retry loop exists. Timeout/transport/auth/parse failures produce unresolved exit 1 and retain only an exact-identity previous observation marked historical (83-96, 128-177). The actual offline success-timeout-rejection test passed with one intercepted GET per call. No cross-process persistence is implemented.

A bounded token alphabet excludes header injection. Token-bearing identities throw the fixed redactedResponse before a request. The token is used only in Authorization; neither token nor arbitrary provider display/error text enters a report. Current/history identity checks prevent a previous reflected identity from being retained. Ephemeral configuration disables shared cache, cookies and credential storage. Redirect delegate refuses forwarding. Tests check malformed/missing/reflected credentials and absence of the offline bearer value in serialized results.

Request and resource timeouts are configured to 30 seconds; waitsForConnectivity is false. Both advertised and incrementally consumed bodies are capped at 262144 bytes. JSON limits are depth 12, values 4096, strings 4096 bytes; release count is at most 20. MIME, response URL, redirect status, auth, access, rate limit and provider errors are explicit. Offline tests exercise injected failures and advertised/streamed byte ceilings. Actual elapsed-time enforcement, platform redirect callback behavior and live Google transport were not independently exercised.

officialApiVerification.supportedClaims: ReleaseSummary uses track, activeArtifacts and releaseLifecycleState; ArtifactSummary.versionCode is an integer. Six specified lifecycle states match the implementation. PUBLISHED covers full/partial rollout and resumable halted releases, so it does not independently prove tester access or serving readiness.

OAuth androidpublisher scope is required.

requiredIntegrationWork: Allow --version-code and --track in BOTH Arguments' option parser and allowedOptions[submit]; keep duplicate-option checks and PlayTestingRequest.parse's exact words/provider/options validation. Add command help.
Map thrown invalidRequest/redactedResponse to fixed structured Play CLI errors without echoing identity, token, arbitrary input or provider content.
Compile the parent-owned full CLI with the top-level await and run offline end-to-end argument/dispatch/output/exit controls; this review does not establish that integration compiles or dispatches.

Preserve exit semantics: 0 means current provider PUBLISHED only, 2 means known pending/not-observed, 1 means rejected/failure/unresolved. Neither exit 0 nor published-on-track can satisfy a testing-readiness, serving, release or GA gate.
